ini.notes: snesrev/zelda3 config (config.c). Sections [General] [Graphics] [Sound] [Features] [KeyMap] [GamepadMap]; `Key = Value`, '#' comment lines. Read once when the game starts. The bottom-screen settings rewrite single lines in place (MinimapView.updateIni) and insert a missing key right under its section header, so the app must be stopped before editing. Copied from the APK only when missing; updates never replace it. A zelda3.user.ini next to it would replace this file entirely (ParseConfigFile).

prefs.notes: SharedPreferences 'secondscreen'. Only hideTopHud is stored here.

extended_aspect_ratio.label: Settings > WIDESCREEN
extended_aspect_ratio.notes: Comma list parsed in order: optional 'extend_y' first (240 lines), then the ratio, then optional 'unchanged_sprites' and/or 'no_visual_fixes'. The bottom-screen row toggles only 4:3 <-> 16:9 (and applies it live). Any other token makes the line invalid. 16:9 is the v2.0 shipped default; an ini first copied by an older version keeps its 4:3.

autosave.label: Settings > AUTOSAVE
autosave.notes: Save a state on quit and load it on start (saves/save0.sav). Parsed with strtol, so use 0/1, not true/false.

second_screen_x_item_ring.label: Settings > X ITEM RING
second_screen_x_item_ring.notes: Bottom screen shows a second ring for the item on X. Needs [Features] ItemSwitchLR = 1; the app turns that on with it.

second_screen_swap.label: Settings > SWAP SCREENS
second_screen_swap.notes: 1 = game on the bottom panel, map/inventory on the top. Read by SetupActivity at launch only. Absent from inis first copied by versions before v2.0 (missing = 0).

second_screen_crt.label: Settings > CRT BOTTOM
second_screen_crt.notes: Scanlines on the bottom screen, independent of [Graphics] CrtFilter.

disable_frame_delay.label: (ini only)
disable_frame_delay.notes: Skip the per-frame SDL_Delay; slightly better performance when the display runs at exactly 60 Hz.

new_renderer.label: (ini only)
new_renderer.notes: Optimised SNES PPU renderer (faster, possibly buggier). Accepts 0/1/true/false/yes/no/on/off.

no_sprite_limits.label: (ini only)
no_sprite_limits.notes: Remove the per-scanline sprite limit (no sprite flicker).

ignore_aspect_ratio.label: (ini only)
ignore_aspect_ratio.notes: 1 = stretch to the window instead of keeping the aspect ratio.

linear_filtering.label: (ini only)
linear_filtering.notes: Bilinear filtering instead of sharp pixels (SDL and OpenGL output).

crt_filter.label: Settings > CRT TOP
crt_filter.notes: Scanlines and a subtle RGB mask on the game screen. Applied live from the bottom screen.

dim_flashes.label: Settings > DIM FLASHES
dim_flashes.notes: Virtual Console style reduced flashing. Lives in [Graphics] although it is a feature bit.

output_method.label: (ini only)
output_method.notes: Unrecognised values fall back to SDL. Shader needs OpenGL or OpenGL ES. OpenGL output not tested on the Thor.

shader.label: (ini only)
shader.notes: Path to a .glsl or .glslp (snesrev/glsl-shaders), relative paths from the files dir. Only with OpenGL/OpenGL ES output. Empty = none.

link_graphics.label: (ini only)
link_graphics.notes: Path to a .zspr sprite sheet that replaces Link (snesrev/sprites-gfx). Commented out in the shipped ini.

audio_samples.label: (ini only)
audio_samples.notes: Audio buffer in samples, power of two; larger = more latency.

enable_msu.label: Settings > MSU MUSIC
enable_msu.notes: Needs a pack at MSUPath (default msu/alttp_msu-<n>.pcm under the files dir); the row reads NO PACK without one. Takes effect at next launch.

msu_volume.label: (ini only)
msu_volume.notes: 0-100; parsed with atoi so the trailing % is optional.

resume_msu.label: (ini only)
resume_msu.notes: Resume the MSU track position when re-entering an overworld area.

item_switch_lr.label: Settings > ITEM SWITCH L R
item_switch_lr.notes: Cycle items with L/R, reorder with Y+direction, assign items to X/L/R. Required by the X item ring. Default is the v2.0 shipped zelda3.ini value; a missing line means 0.

item_switch_lr_limit.label: (ini only)
item_switch_lr_limit.notes: Limit L/R cycling to the first 4 items. Default is the v2.0 shipped zelda3.ini value; a missing line means 0.

turn_while_dashing.label: Settings > TURN WHILE DASH
turn_while_dashing.notes: Default is the v2.0 shipped zelda3.ini value; a missing line means 0.

mirror_to_darkworld.label: Settings > MIRROR TO DARK
mirror_to_darkworld.notes: Mirror warps to the Dark World too. Default is the v2.0 shipped zelda3.ini value; a missing line means 0.

collect_items_with_sword.label: Settings > COLLECT BY SWORD
collect_items_with_sword.notes: Default is the v2.0 shipped zelda3.ini value; a missing line means 0.

break_pots_with_sword.label: Settings > SWORD BREAKS POTS
break_pots_with_sword.notes: Level 2-4 sword breaks pots. Default is the v2.0 shipped zelda3.ini value; a missing line means 0.

disable_low_health_beep.label: Settings > LOW HP BEEP (shown inverted)
disable_low_health_beep.notes: 1 = no beep; the bottom-screen row shows the beep itself, so ON there means 0 here. Default is the v2.0 shipped zelda3.ini value; a missing line means 0.

skip_intro_on_keypress.label: Settings > SKIP INTRO
skip_intro_on_keypress.notes: Default is the v2.0 shipped zelda3.ini value; a missing line means 0.

show_max_items_in_yellow.label: Settings > MAX ITEMS YELLOW
show_max_items_in_yellow.notes: Default is the v2.0 shipped zelda3.ini value; a missing line means 0.

more_active_bombs.label: Settings > MORE BOMBS
more_active_bombs.notes: Four bombs at once instead of two. Default is the v2.0 shipped zelda3.ini value; a missing line means 0.

carry_more_rupees.label: Settings > CARRY 9999 RUPEES
carry_more_rupees.notes: Default is the v2.0 shipped zelda3.ini value; a missing line means 0.

misc_bug_fixes.label: (ini only)
misc_bug_fixes.notes: Various original-game bug fixes. Default is the v2.0 shipped zelda3.ini value; a missing line means 0.

game_changing_bug_fixes.label: (ini only)
game_changing_bug_fixes.notes: Bug fixes that change game behaviour. Default is the v2.0 shipped zelda3.ini value; a missing line means 0.

cancel_bird_travel.label: Settings > CANCEL BIRD RIDE
cancel_bird_travel.notes: Cancel bird travel with X. Default is the v2.0 shipped zelda3.ini value; a missing line means 0.

gamepad_controls.label: Settings > REMAP BUTTONS
gamepad_controls.default: DpadUp, DpadDown, DpadLeft, DpadRight, Back, Start, A, B, X, Y, Lb, Rb
gamepad_controls.notes: 12 comma-separated pad buttons in SNES order Up, Down, Left, Right, Select, Start, A, B, X, Y, L, R. Default is the Nintendo layout for the Thor; Xbox-style pads use '..., B, A, Y, X, Lb, Rb'. The bottom-screen remap rewrites this line.

turbo_button.label: (ini only)
turbo_button.notes: Pad button held for fast-forward. Names as in Controls (L1/Lb, L2, L3, R1/Rb, R2, R3, A, B, X, Y, Back, Start, Dpad*).

hide_top_hud.label: Settings > HIDE TOP HUD
hide_top_hud.notes: Hide the game's own HUD strip on the top screen (the bottom screen shows hearts, magic and counters). getBoolean default is true. Applied live.
